inputs.text: Ordinary families are already paying the price in higher energy costs and canceled flights. Leaders must explain plainly what this war is supposed to accomplish and what burdens they are imposing on the public. Defending Israel matters, but no government should commit the country to an open-ended conflict without clear objectives and a credible path to success. National security takes resolve—and responsible leadership that puts the nation’s interests and families’ welfare first.
